scope: Visible shared Drive metadata, already accepted adapter inventory, and score/day0 archive member inventory plus configuration-only conversion report. No training rows parsed or copied.

training_score_folder.limitations: A conversion report establishes tokenizer/data preparation settings, not the actual step30 training run or its loss weighting. Reward/advantage distributions and train/val row values were not exported.

documented_semantics: One operation per row; ordinary shuffled DataLoader
Episode advantage copied to each operation, then broadcast over response mask
Default training example is 9B, batch and mini-batch 32 with ppo_epochs=1

remaining_needed: step30 resolved training configuration or launch record
Actual dataset sampler and loss aggregation implementation at its training revision
method_decision: Do not infer a training bug or prescribe blanket inverse-chain-length weighting from these artifacts.
inspection_attempts: v1 stopped with RuntimeError at the bounded read and exported no inventory; retained remotely.
v2 exported a 2MiB partial prefix ending at train.parquet; not treated as complete.
v3 and v4 reached tar end with the same transferred-prefix digest; v4 additionally scanned the small conversion report.
